note: Index-first selection: shortlist here, then read only 2-4 pattern files. Performance and complexity are cost levels (low|medium|high). Inspiration sites are inspiration, not performance evidence.

patterns.name: Scroll Gallery Rails
patterns.communicates: abundance, range, curation — 'we have a deep body of visual work'
best_for: portfolios and studios with 8+ strong visuals
case-study or product-photography collections
campaign lookbooks and editorial archives
avoid_when: fewer than 8 strong media items
content is text- or spec-led
conversion-critical pages where scanning speed matters most
patterns.asset_profile: 8-20 consistent, art-directed images/videos with alt text and stable aspect ratios
patterns.mobile_strategy: native swipe carousel or vertical stack; no scroll-linked horizontal motion on touch

patterns.name: Scrollytelling Chapters
patterns.communicates: cause and effect, process, guided explanation — 'follow this story step by step'
best_for: how-it-works and process explanations with 3+ causal steps
data stories and annotated visualizations
brand origin or transformation narratives
avoid_when: content is a flat list with no causal order
users primarily scan, compare, or transact
the story has fewer than 3 meaningful chapters
patterns.asset_profile: one strong visual per chapter (diagram, photo, chart, or product state) plus concise chapter copy
patterns.mobile_strategy: shorter pin distances or unpinned stacked chapters; progress indicator preserved

patterns.name: Parallax Depth Planes
patterns.communicates: atmosphere, place, layered richness — 'this world has depth'
best_for: hero scenes for place-, product-, or mood-led brands
section transitions using masks and overlap reveals
storytelling backdrops behind editorial content
avoid_when: dense informational or utility pages
imagery lacks separable foreground/background layers
motion sensitivity is a primary audience concern and no budget exists for a strong static design
patterns.asset_profile: 2-4 separable layers per scene (cutout PNG/SVG/photo planes) or gradient/mask compositions
patterns.mobile_strategy: reduce to 1-2 planes with smaller offsets, or flatten to a designed static composition

patterns.name: Kinetic & Variable Typography
patterns.communicates: voice, personality, editorial confidence — 'the words themselves are the brand'
best_for: type-led brands, studios, publications, campaigns
manifesto or statement heroes with little imagery
brands with a licensed variable font worth showing off
avoid_when: long-form reading or dense UI copy
no distinctive licensed typeface is available
headline copy is not yet finalized or strong
patterns.asset_profile: licensed display/variable font (subset), finalized short headline copy; no imagery required
patterns.mobile_strategy: smaller axis ranges and shorter durations; entrance-only animation instead of continuous motion

patterns.name: Media Scrub Reveal
patterns.communicates: transformation, craftsmanship, precision — 'watch it change/assemble under your control'
best_for: physical-product assembly or exploded views
before/after transformations tied to the value proposition
process reveals where user-controlled pacing adds understanding
avoid_when: no professionally produced image sequence or scrub-ready video exists
the transformation is not central to the message
budget requires strict low-bandwidth performance
patterns.asset_profile: produced image sequence (30-120 optimized frames) or keyframe-dense video, plus a hero-quality static fallback frame
patterns.mobile_strategy: fewer/smaller frames or a tap-to-play video; never scroll-linked scrubbing on constrained devices

patterns.name: View & Shared-Element Transitions
patterns.communicates: continuity, polish, spatial coherence — 'this site is one continuous place'
best_for: index-to-detail flows (work grids, product lists, articles)
multi-page sites needing app-like continuity
low-cost polish accent on almost any site
avoid_when: single-page sites with no navigation to smooth
transitions would delay content on slow connections
team cannot maintain progressive enhancement for non-supporting browsers
patterns.asset_profile: no new assets; requires consistent shared elements (thumbnail to hero image, title) across pages
patterns.mobile_strategy: same transitions with shorter durations; instant navigation stays the baseline

patterns.name: WebGL Product Stage
patterns.communicates: spatial understanding, technical sophistication — 'inspect it from every angle'
best_for: physical products whose form/configuration matters to the purchase
configurators (materials, colors, options)
spatial or architectural subjects
avoid_when: no production-quality 3D model exists or can be commissioned
a photo or video communicates the product equally well
the page must stay lightweight or the team cannot maintain a 3D pipeline
patterns.asset_profile: optimized glTF/GLB model (compressed, LOD-ready), HDRI/lighting setup, and a high-quality 2D fallback render
patterns.mobile_strategy: reduced geometry/texture budget, capped device pixel ratio, tap-to-activate; static render on low-power devices

patterns.name: Cursor & Focus Previews
patterns.communicates: density made light, curiosity — 'peek before you commit to a click'
best_for: dense text indexes (work lists, article archives, rosters)
portfolios where a text list is the primary navigation
adding richness without heavy page media
avoid_when: index has fewer than ~6 items
preview media does not exist for most items
touch-first audience with no meaningful hover behavior planned
patterns.asset_profile: one lightweight preview image/clip per index item (lazy-loaded), consistent aspect ratio
patterns.mobile_strategy: inline thumbnails, expandable rows, or first-tap-previews/second-tap-navigates with visible affordance

patterns.name: Editorial Collage Grid
patterns.communicates: taste, curation, magazine-grade art direction — 'a human composed this'
best_for: editorial brands, studios, culture and fashion sites
mixed media (photo + type + graphic) storytelling sections
differentiating from uniform card-grid competitors
avoid_when: content is homogeneous and comparison-oriented (specs, pricing)
imagery is weak, inconsistent, or sparse
CMS-driven content changes shape unpredictably
patterns.asset_profile: 6-12 art-directed images with intentional crops and stable aspect ratios; strong display typography
patterns.mobile_strategy: recomposed single-column rhythm with deliberate scale contrast, not a collapsed grid

patterns.name: Draggable Inertial Gallery
patterns.communicates: tactile exploration, abundance — 'dig through the collection with your hands'
best_for: archives and collections with 15+ strong items
exploratory browsing where discovery is the point
brands whose identity is tactile/physical
avoid_when: collection is small or must be seen in full quickly
users need ordered comparison or filtering as the primary task
keyboard/AT-equivalent navigation cannot be provided
patterns.asset_profile: 15+ optimized, lazy-loaded media items with alt text; consistent visual quality across the set
patterns.mobile_strategy: native touch scrolling with scroll-snap; custom inertia only where it beats native feel

patterns.name: Honest Asset Loader
patterns.communicates: anticipation, brand ritual — 'the wait itself is designed'
best_for: experiences with genuinely unavoidable heavy loading (WebGL, media scrub, large sequences)
floating-image collage intros that preload real gallery assets
campaign/exhibition sites where an entrance moment fits the brand
avoid_when: the page could simply load fast instead (most sites)
loader would delay LCP beyond budget
no real assets are being loaded (decorative fake loaders are forbidden)
patterns.asset_profile: the real heavy assets being preloaded; loader visuals reuse actual site imagery/wordmark
patterns.mobile_strategy: shorter or skipped loader; never gate content behind an animation on slow connections

patterns.name: State Microinteractions
patterns.communicates: care, responsiveness, quality-in-the-details — 'this product is well made'
best_for: sticky summary/CTA cards, reading progress, view-timeline section reveals
state-aware UI (saved, loading, success, empty) that earns trust
any site as a supporting accent — the default creative floor
avoid_when: used to disguise the absence of a real content or design idea
reveals hide above-the-fold content from crawlers or reduced-motion users
every element animates — accents must stay scarce
patterns.asset_profile: none beyond existing UI; optionally small inline SVG for progress/state icons
patterns.mobile_strategy: identical behavior; sticky elements sized for thumbs and safe areas
